label: Bible Study
prompt: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the _____ of God is stronger than men.
verse: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
note: God's 'foolishness' outsmarts us, and his 'weakness' outmuscles us.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good _____ through grace,
verse: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
note: Everlasting consolation and good hope, given through grace — Paul's gift list for an anxious church.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the people took their _____ before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
verse: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
note: Israel left so fast the bread never rose — they carried the dough out on their shoulders, kneading troughs and all.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without _____ is dead also.
verse: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
note: James's closing analogy: faith without works is a corpse — the breath is gone, only the body remains.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He that _____ a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
verse: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
note: Answering a matter before you've heard it is 'folly and shame' — the ancient rule against interrupting.
